user.title: New Crescendo object
user.description: Name the object and pick its lights. Stops, colors and buttons are set up on the **Crescendo** page in the sidebar.

fade_to.name: Fade to position
fade_to.description: Moves the object along its scale over any duration. Every light follows its own sequence.

position.name: Position
position.description: Target on the scale from 0 to 100. 0 switches everything off.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long the fade takes. There is no upper limit here. Without a value, the object's default applies.

stop.name: Stop fade
stop.description: Stops a running fade and keeps the lights where they are.

press_button.name: Press button
press_button.description: Runs one of the object's standard buttons.

set_on_position.name: Set switch-on position
set_on_position.description: Sets where a plain switch-on goes, for example by time of day from another automation or integration. Without a position, the object's own setting applies again.

reset_color.name: Reset color
reset_color.description: Ends a chosen color and returns to the colors of the stops.
